abyssal_depths.name: abyssal_depths
abyssal_depths.description: Flooded caldera below the volcano. Rarest gathering nodes on the isle, and the sealed chamber of the Last Elder.

rare_drops.comment: 20% chance for a bonus second sigil

abyssal_ruins.name: abyssal_ruins
abyssal_ruins.description: Ancient ruins that exist simultaneously above and below the water's surface. Abyssal leeches, deep horrors, and void guardians protect whatever the ruins were built to contain.

abyssal_throne.name: abyssal_throne
abyssal_throne.description: The deepest point in the known world — a vast cavern where void lords have held dominion since before recorded history. Few have entered. Fewer have returned.

ancient_forest.name: ancient_forest
ancient_forest.description: Overgrown ruins under a canopy of abyssal trees. The Elders' buried library sleeps here.

ancient_forest_ruins.name: ancient_forest_ruins
ancient_forest_ruins.description: Stone ruins swallowed by the primeval forest, now haunted by corrupted druids, vine beasts, and forest spirits who guard the grove's ancient secrets.

ancient_forge.name: ancient_forge
ancient_forge.description: A vast dwarven forge that has burned for centuries without tending. Iron golems and forge demons guard its secrets, and dwarven guardians stand ready to repel any intruder.

ancient_temple.name: ancient_temple
ancient_temple.description: An ancient temple guarded by the most powerful creatures in the realm. Only the strongest warriors dare enter.

arcane_ruins.name: arcane_ruins
arcane_ruins.description: The functional underground chambers of a destroyed wizard's tower. Arcane constructs follow their last orders with no master left to countermand them. Corrupted mages drawn to the residual magic make the ruins doubly dangerous.

bandit_camp.name: bandit_camp
bandit_camp.description: A hideout of thieves and rogues in the wilderness. Watch your coin purse!

beach_and_cliffs.name: beach_and_cliffs
beach_and_cliffs.description: The isle's landing zone. Coastal enemies fresh off the wreck of prior voyages.

blightwood.name: blightwood
blightwood.description: A rotting forest deep past the Hollowfen, where the Gloomharvest's strongest horrors gather. Part of the Gloomharvest event.

cloud_kingdom.name: cloud_kingdom
cloud_kingdom.description: A realm above the clouds, reached by climbing a legendary beanstalk. Giants roam vast floating islands, sky serpents drift between the cloudbanks, and storm imps crackle with restless energy. Few have seen it. Fewer still have returned to speak of it.
cloud_kingdom.lore_hint: A rare seed is said to hold the way...

collapsed_mine.name: collapsed_mine
collapsed_mine.description: A vast cavern beneath the copper mines. Cave trolls and rock golems haunt the rubble, and giant spiders spin webs across the collapsed shafts.

corrupted_sanctum.name: corrupted_sanctum
corrupted_sanctum.description: A shadow-drenched sanctum at the heart of the corrupted canopy. Shadow beasts stalk the halls, twisted treants block the passages, and corrupted mages channel the darkness.

dragon_lair.name: dragon_lair
dragon_lair.description: The legendary home of green dragons. Only master warriors survive this challenge.

drowned_temple.name: drowned_temple
drowned_temple.description: A sunken temple beneath the sea grotto, its halls filled with brine and ancient sorrow. Drowned cultists drift through the corridors alongside sea spirits and cursed fishermen.

farm.name: farm
farm.description: A peaceful farm with livestock. Great for beginners looking to gather food!

fortress_ruins.name: fortress_ruins
fortress_ruins.description: The crumbling remains of an ancient castle, now guarded by knights and soldiers.

frozen_citadel.name: frozen_citadel
frozen_citadel.description: A fortress entombed beneath a glacier for a thousand years. Its halls are preserved in perfect silence, and the ancient defenders still patrol their posts.

glacier_hollows.name: glacier_hollows
glacier_hollows.description: Blue-lit caverns carved through the glacier, home to the Frostfall's fiercest beasts. Part of the Frostfall event.

goblin_cave.name: goblin_cave
goblin_cave.description: A dark cave infested with goblins and giant rats. A good place for new adventurers to train.

guild_of_shadows.name: guild_of_shadows
guild_of_shadows.description: The innermost sanctum of the thieves' guild — a place few have found and fewer have left. The guild's most elite enforcers protect its deepest secrets.

hollowfen.name: hollowfen
hollowfen.description: A mist-drowned marsh of sunken barrows where the harvest dead walk. Part of the Gloomharvest event.

imp_cavern.name: imp_cavern
imp_cavern.description: A shallow cave filled with mischievous imps. Perfect for absolute beginners!

infernal_stronghold.name: infernal_stronghold
infernal_stronghold.description: A fortress of fire and brimstone, ruled by demons and hellhounds. The heat alone can kill the unprepared.

orc_stronghold.name: orc_stronghold
orc_stronghold.description: A fortified orc settlement deep in the mountains. Only the brave dare enter.

rimewaste.name: rimewaste
rimewaste.description: A wind-scoured snowfield where the Frostfall's creatures drift down from the peaks. Part of the Frostfall event.

rogue_sanctum.name: rogue_sanctum
rogue_sanctum.description: The guild's inner refuge — a fortified hideout accessible only to proven members. Trespassers are dealt with swiftly and without mercy.

shadow_den.name: shadow_den
shadow_den.description: A network of underground chambers used by the region's thieves and cutpurses as a base of operations. The rogues here are well-armed and very hostile to uninvited guests.

spider_den.name: spider_den
spider_den.description: A web-filled cavern crawling with venomous spiders. Bring antivenom!

sunspire.name: sunspire
sunspire.description: A sun-tower ruin cracked open by the solstice, spilling heat spirits into the region. Part of the Sunspire Solstice event.

thornmeadow.name: thornmeadow
thornmeadow.description: A meadow gone wild with the spring thaw, its flowers hiding thorns and teeth. Part of the Bloomtide event.

undead_crypt.name: undead_crypt
undead_crypt.description: An ancient burial ground where the dead refuse to rest. Beware the dark magic!

void_rift.name: void_rift
void_rift.description: A tear in reality that bleeds void creatures into the mortal world. The air crackles with chaotic energy and the ground shimmers with otherworldly light.

volcanic_depths.name: volcanic_depths
volcanic_depths.description: A scorching cavern inhabited by hellhounds and lesser demons. The heat is unbearable!

volcano_peak.name: volcano_peak
volcano_peak.description: Ash slopes and lava vents. Only cooked Deepwater Ray keeps you upright at these vents.

wildgrove.name: wildgrove
wildgrove.description: An ancient grove past the Thornmeadow where the Thorn Queen's court takes root. Part of the Bloomtide event.
